fusions.name: Word of Halting
fusions.desc: Speaks a word of iron at an enemy up to 7 tiles away, dealing 12 damage and leaving it [Stunned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Recited Bolts
fusions.desc: Looses 3 bolts of iron-grey force at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Spoken Bulwark
fusions.desc: Speaks a ward of iron that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and your armour rises by 8% while it holds.

fusions.name: Unbroken Litany
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 6% of your maximum health per stack (34% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
